name: Canva
tagline: Design and video for teams without a full-time designer
description: Browser-based design and video platform with millions of templates, brand kits and AI tools, built for small teams that ship visuals without a designer.
priceNote: Pro is $12 per person/month billed yearly ($18 month-to-month); Business starts at $20.83 per person/month billed yearly and scales with team size. Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Marketing and social teams that need on-brand assets without a designer
pros: Templates plus a drag-and-drop editor let a non-designer ship credible work in minutes
Brand kits lock fonts, colours and logos so every freelancer stays on brand
Magic Studio handles background removal, resizing and copy generation in one click
The free tier is usable for real social posts, so you can start before paying anything
cons: Per-seat pricing punishes a team where only two people publish often
Business billing scales with headcount, which surprises teams after a hiring spree
Advanced editing still trails Photoshop and Illustrator for print-ready artwork
Rights on stock assets and AI-generated output are murkier than the terms suggest

features.name: Templates and brand kits
features.detail: Millions of templates with locked brand colours, fonts and logos

features.name: Magic Studio AI
features.detail: Background removal, resize, image generation and copy in one click

features.name: Video and motion
features.detail: Timeline editor with captions, transitions and auto reframe

features.name: Decks and documents
features.detail: Presentations, whiteboards and printable pieces from the same canvas

features.name: Review and approval
features.detail: Comment threads, shared folders and one-click sign-off for campaigns

features.name: Content planner
features.detail: Schedule and publish to social channels without leaving Canva

useCases: Produce a month of social posts for a small brand without hiring a freelance designer
Turn a webinar recording into a promo clip with captions for the sales team to share
Build a client pitch deck over a weekend using a shared brand kit
Standardise product photos and promo templates across a small e-commerce catalogue
bestForWho: SMB marketing and social teams that need consistent, on-brand visuals fast and cannot justify a full-time designer.
verdict: Canva is the fastest way for a small team to produce something that looks professionally designed without a designer in the room. The brand kit feature is what turns it from a nice toy into a system: once colours, fonts and logos are locked, a freelancer can build a launch kit that still looks like your brand. Magic Studio saves real time on the repetitive work, particularly background removal and resizing a single asset for five channels. The catch is pricing model drift, because Business bills on actual headcount and the bill changes as people join and leave. Print-ready and advanced retouching are still not there, so serious product work ends in Adobe, though for social, ads and internal collateral it earns its place in the stack.
